body.message: Peninsula Five studio is available for 3 months at AED 5,000/month. Beyond that, rates are reviewed closer to the time, so a 6-month lock-in isn't something we can confirm upfront, though extensions are very much possible. Which of the two options works better for you, 3 months to start, or would you prefer to explore the 6-month route and we'll sort the rate as it comes?
